# ArQonnect

> ArQonnect is an AI twin platform for customer conversations. Businesses manage WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, and website chat in one inbox, answered by AI they control, with human handoff built in.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://www.arqonnect.io/): Product overview — one inbox, AI Twin, human handoff
- [Services](https://www.arqonnect.io/services): Twin platform capabilities and growth add-ons
- [Industries](https://www.arqonnect.io/industries): Clinics, real estate, retail, services, hospitality
- [Case studies](https://www.arqonnect.io/case-studies): Representative Twin deployment scenarios
- [ROI calculator](https://www.arqonnect.io/roi): Illustrative cost of missed chats vs plan pricing
- [How it works](https://www.arqonnect.io/process): Setup from channels to CRM
- [Live demo](https://www.arqonnect.io/demo): What prospects see in a scoped demo
- [Pricing](https://www.arqonnect.io/pricing): Starter, Growth, and Scale SaaS plans
- [FAQ](https://www.arqonnect.io/faq): Buyer questions on handoff, languages, and knowledge
- [Contact](https://www.arqonnect.io/contact): Book a demo or reach the team
- [About](https://www.arqonnect.io/about): Company, leadership, and contact roles
- [Book a meeting](https://cal.com/abdul-rehman/30min): 30-minute Cal.com demo booking

## Pricing (USD, excl. tax)

- Starter: $499/mo + $2,000 setup — web chat, 500 conversations, 1 location
- Growth: $899/mo + $4,000 setup — web + WhatsApp, 2,000 conversations, up to 2 locations
- Scale: $1,499/mo + $6,500 setup — all 4 channels, 6,000 conversations, up to 3 locations
- Yearly billing: 1 month free. Payments via Paddle (Merchant of Record).
